doc.title: Zutty Singleton and Marge Singleton Interview, 1969-02-08

chapter: Marge Singleton's St. Louis memories of Jelly Roll
title: Jelly Roll's bragging and bad reputation
summary: Asked about Jelly's reputation, Zutty says he talked and bragged a lot and could back it up, and gathered a crowd in five minutes. Much of the rest is unintelligible.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press
